last_observed_gap.definition: Recorded delta_t of last observed event, valid only when >=2 observations are inside exact loader context; never target delta_t

last_three_observed_span.definition: Sum of recorded delta_t of last and previous observed event, valid only when >=3 observations are inside exact loader context

group_definition.quantile_source: unique Train targets across seeds, each feature eligible histories only
group_definition.ties: if Q25>=Q75 mark low_high_not_separable; do not alter quantiles

matching.weight: Only cells with both low and high; each direction mass=min(n_low,n_high); per row mass/n_group

report: match balance for continuous target quantity/change magnitude
interpretation: Descriptive condition comparison, including target-quantity conditioning. It does not isolate elapsed time as a CNN defect or demonstrate a successful architecture. Seeds reuse identical targets. Sparse coverage cannot generalize to all RAF. No inference, training, Test or remote operations.
